text_block_list.text: "CASE: Routine Patrol"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Meno & Biko
text_block_list.text:
Seeeeei!
Haaaa!
(SMACK!)

On this day, Fenomeno had been invited by Biko Pegasus,
a sprint Umamusume with a heart of justice,
to cross swords at the academy's dojo.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Phaaa! Fenomeno-senpai is super strong with a sword too!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hahaha. My father has trained me with rolled-up newspapers since I was a small child, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ! Just like me! ...Is it because both Fenomeno-senpai's dad and my dad are police officers?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha.
I suppose that's a common experience.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Fenomeno, so this is where you were!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Biko, Trainer! Hey there!
The one who appeared was Bamboo Memory, the head of the Morals Committee to which Fenomeno belongs.
choice_data_list: Hello. Seeing as you're here, that must mean...
Hello. Seeing as you're here, that must mean...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Did something happen in the committee?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not about trouble on the committee!
It's about you guys! Fenomeno!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay!? Are you hurting inside!?
Everyone on the Disciplinary Committee was worried about you!
choice_data_list: Worried about Phenomeno and the others...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My fans are doing something strange
on the internet...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...Wah!
Could this be it...?"

That uproar on social media
had started from a tiny spark at first.

text_block_list.name: ＠0x0_987654
text_block_list.text:
""【My First Race Report】
Kyoto Racecourse is so insanely beautiful!
It was my first time going, but I was totally blown away.""

text_block_list.name: ＠0x0_987654
text_block_list.text:
"The funniest one was Gold Ship, I think?
She brought in a robot... Turns out races allow
surprisingly a lot of goofing around!"

text_block_list.name: @Golshi_Sushi_3
text_block_list.text:
""@0x0_987654
She's a pretty special case, so...
Everyone else is super hardworking and serious...!""

text_block_list.name: @00RaceRace00
text_block_list.text:
""Ugh... Isn't that viral post really bad?
The Tenno Sho Spring is supposed to be a prestigious stage.
Newcomers are gonna get totally the wrong idea~""

text_block_list.name: @RailBuddy01
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi is just for comic relief.
If you take her seriously, you've already lost lol"

text_block_list.name: @Turf_Taro
text_block_list.text: "You're underestimating her. Golshi won the Kikuka Sho too, you know. Plus, letting Golshi get away with it annoys me."

text_block_list.name: @Haha-musume_Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
" 'It's honestly sad that nowadays, those who stand out win,
while girls working hard behind the scenes go unappreciated.
Has racing always been this superficial?' "

text_block_list.name: @MenoMenon
text_block_list.text:
"Fenomeno is an ally of justice!
She's completely different from Golshi, who just stirs up trouble!"

text_block_list.name: @Turf_Dweller
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi, you've got better things to do than fool around!
Fenomeno, keep her in line!"

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi is—" "Golshi is—"
"Golshi is—" "Golshi is—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's angry...
Golshi-senpai looks like the bad guy...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Besides, this would give
my victory over her a completely different meaning...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...I really don't think this situation is good, boss.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the report.
I'm glad we caught it at this timing.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If my being treated as an "ally of justice"
has caused Gold Ship-san to be treated like this...
then that's...――...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ............No, it is not 'nice to meet you' at all.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What should we do, Boss!
Should I post our explanation on this 'Internet' thing!?
choice_data_list: ...No, that might be a bit careless.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Ah!!
That's right, at times like this...!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
And so you came seeking Curren's advice!
Well then, pardon me♪
The sprint Umamusume Biko Pegasus introduced to me, Curren Chan, is one of the top social media experts at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho... I see, I see.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...! This kind of thing might be hard to fix right away.
Can we talk about things to watch out for instead?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's still a big help.
Yeah, that would still be a big help!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno-san. You shouldn't reply directly to these people by mentioning them.
Provoking them is a big no-no!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Guh, is that so...
choice_data_list: Is there anything else I should watch out for?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Basically, I should be careful
with my actions so the fire doesn't get wildly out of hand, and...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Setting up an official account for Fenomeno-san might actually be a good idea ♪
It could help keep things under control, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's just a little heads-up to say,
"Fenomeno and the others are keeping an eye
on the internet scene too~"♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And if there's ever something you just have to say, please post it from that account. ...Using appropriate words, of course!
choice_data_list: Something I just have to convey, huh...

text_block_list.text: After receiving further guidance from Curren Chan for a while, we left the shop.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"What I can do right now
is to 'avoid providing any sparks that could ignite trouble'...
that's all..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to act completely like normal, though.
Curren-san taught me that reacting to it often just makes things worse, too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
And to make sure Golshi-san
doesn't get treated like the bad guy...
choice_data_list: I'll take care of whatever else I can handle.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...I apologize for causing you
such trouble."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"However, we've never received feedback like this before,
so why all of a sudden...?"
choice_data_list: ...Because the opposite of evil is justice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...?
It is indeed treated that way, but...
choice_data_list: Maybe you just want to be the one in the right.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I want to be on the right side...
choice_data_list: Of course, though that might not be the case.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed, righteousness lies
with whichever side holds legitimacy."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“Still, assuming that all of one's actions are justified
just because they are on the 'right' side
is a dangerous way of thinking....”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My father, a police officer, used to say:
If you're too overconfident that you're in the right and brand others as evil, tragedy can strike.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Golshi-san is not evil.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss.
Golshi-san is someone who relentlessly pursues fun.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
So I won't hold back
in a serious race. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If our next race brings out our true, utmost potential even more than before...
then perhaps people will start seeing things differently.
choice_data_list: That sounds like it's worth it.
That sounds like it's worth it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ――! Haah!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Aside from us, it's been reported that Orfe-san and Gentile-san are slated to run in the upcoming Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
And among them, as Golshi-san's rival!
I swear right here and now that we will bring out
each other's fighting spirit to the utmost!!
